purpose: Defines the fields, preconditions, and structure of the 'Patient Identification & Order Verification' screen within workflow WF_001.
preconditions: An active imaging order exists in the system
Patient has been registered for the current encounter
postconditions: All required fields on 'Patient Identification & Order Verification' are captured and saved before advancing to the next screen.
validations: Confirm two patient identifiers (name and date of birth) match the order
Confirm the imaging order number is active and not cancelled
Confirm order priority (routine, urgent, STAT) is correctly reflected
common_errors: Order number entered does not match any active order
Patient identifiers mismatch between screen and order record
